title: Pokemon TCG Gardevoir Sword & Shield - Lost Origin 69/196 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Pokémon TCG SWSH Lost Origin Radiant Gardevoir #69/196 is a Psychic-type Pokémon card from the Sword & Shield set. This Radiant Rare card features Gardevoir, a Psychic/Fairy creature with 130 HP, and a holographic finish. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2022, this English-language card is suitable for players aged 6 and up, making it a valuable addition to any Pokémon TCG collection.
